text.text_excerpt: After enjoying a really rich dinner at N7, my boyfriend and I decided to stop here for a little dessert. Bittersweet Confections is one of the stands located in the St. Roch Market. It's perfect to "pop in" and just grab something sweet, because it's right inside when you walk in and conveniently located next to Coast Roast coffee. We decided to get a couple of the strawberry cupcakes. Not only were they fresh, but they were DELICIOUS. I'm usually disappointed by strawberry cupcakes, because they usually only give you a little hint of strawberry, but this cupcake delivered with it's strawberry filling! Oh yeah, it was filled and I had no idea until I bit into it. It was a pretty fantastic...

Located inside St. Roch Market, on the right side when you come in. My husband and I came by this little confectionery eatery this afternoon around 2:30 pm. There was only another couple in front of us in line ordering a box full of baked goodies. Because of this incredibly humid and hot day, we were in the mood for some ice cream. I ended up getting 2 scoops of ice cream, $5.25 prior to tax (or $5.77 after). We picked molasses oatmeal cookie and mint chocolate chip. The molasses oatmeal cookie was pretty sweet but had a great flavor. I liked the surprised raisins in it. The mint chocolate chip was pretty standard but good. Service was friendly (you can get samples of the ice cream prior ...

I've had this place bookmarked for quite some time after seeing a fellow yelper post a review. Located inside of the St Roch market, a place I am not frequently near, on a Saturday, it was easy enough to park and go inside. It wasn't as packed as I thought it would be. I picked out a lemon bar, a birthday cake cupcake and a wedding cake cupcake to go. After having all three (not at once) all were quite good. The lemon bar was tangy and had a crispy bit of whipped cream on top that balanced out the tang. The cupcakes were both quite lovely. The service at this booth was efficient and quick.
